Question
========
Which of the following is a valid use of `group_by()` and `summarize()`?

Answerlist
----------

-   data |> group_by(sex) |> summarize(freq = n())

-   summarize(group_by(data, age), mean(sex))

-   data |> summarize(mean = group_by(sex))

-   group_by(data, summarize(sex))
